scope: Voice-widget pin is a validated device-local preference, excluded from account synchronization/cache import and preserved across account reset. It blocks native movement unlock and re-locks an already unlocked widget; a pin indicator reflects the state.

Main-only overlay placement uses normalized offsets relative to the desktop/game rectangle. Contexts are desktop or opaque registered game UUIDs, not paths/titles/process inventories. Different games cannot inherit another game's offset. Position adapts to DPI-converted workarea changes and remains bounded; resize scale remains in existing device-local voice preferences.

The versioned dedicated overlay-layout.json store bounds input to 16 KiB plus one overflow-detection byte, validates at most 33 contexts and finite normalized points, rejects symlink/non-regular targets, and uses exclusive same-directory temporary files plus atomic rename with cache rollback on failure. No new server model or account data flow was added.

Lock/hide/window teardown preserve current manual placement. Explicit corner selection clears only that context's offset. Removing a registered game attempts cleanup of its obsolete layout context. Save failure is visibly surfaced rather than claiming persistence.

Trusted-main-frame reset IPC clears only dedicated overlay placements. Renderer resets position to bottom-left and scale to 100 only after true acknowledgment; audio devices, gain, visibility and pin choices remain unchanged. Failed reset preserves current preferences; newer edits beat late responses and successful device updates survive settings-view unmount.
Settings navigation additionally preserves explicitly marked leaf labels without reintroducing whole-section help text as sidebar headings.
